subject: biology-2
question: Which of the following environmental conditions would most strongly favor the evolution of **external fertilization** over **internal fertilization**?

options.text: A dry desert habitat where gametes quickly dry out.
An aquatic habitat where many males and females release gametes into the water at the same time.
A habitat with few individuals, where encounters between mates are rare.
A habitat with heavy predation on exposed eggs and sperm.

explanation: External fertilization works best in aquatic habitats where many individuals release eggs and sperm into the water together, because water protects the gametes and brings them together. A dry habitat, rare encounters between mates, and heavy predation on exposed gametes would all favor internal fertilization, which protects gametes and eggs inside the body.
